name: Voice Memo
author: RmnSoni
description: Voice-memo pipeline control in the bar: toggle the mic recorder, see live recording time, and a badge for recordings not yet transcribed.

barWidget.description: Mic voice-memo recorder toggle with live elapsed time and an un-transcribed recordings badge. Wired to omarchy-soundrecord and omarchy-voicenote. Left-click toggles recording, middle-click transcribes the backlog, right-click opens the recordings folder.

schema.label: Recordings folder
schema.description: Leave empty to follow OMARCHY_SOUNDRECORD_DIR / XDG_MUSIC_DIR (default ~/Music/Recordings).
